entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6351"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 76</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.76.1-Ps.76.12">Psa 76:1-12</reference>. On Neginoth--(See on <reference osisRef="Ps.4.1">Psa 4:1</reference>, title). This Psalm commemorates what the preceding anticipates: God's deliverance of His people by a signal interposition of power against their enemies. The occasion was probably the events narrated in <reference osisRef="2Kgs.19.35">2Ki 19:35</reference>; <reference osisRef="Isa.37.1-Isa.37.28">Is 37:1-28</reference>. (Compare <reference osisRef="Ps.46.1-Ps.46.11">Psa 46:1-11</reference>).</title> <div sID="gen9733" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6351"/>1-2. These well-known terms denote God's people and Church and His intimate and glorious relations to them. <div eID="gen9733" type="x-p"/>
